blocks.text: Miqdor so'zlari — qaysi ot bilan, qaysi gapda

Asoslarni bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 83- va 84-darslar): **much** va **little** — sanalmaydigan ot bilan (much time, little money), **many** va **few** — ko'plikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan (many friends, few cars). O'zbekchada esa «ko'p» va «kam» ikkala holatda ham bir xil: «ko'p vaqt», «ko'p do'st». Shuning uchun avval otga qarang: uni sanash mumkinmi (→ 69–70-darslar)? Bu darsda asosiy savollar boshqa: much / many darak gapda nega g'alati eshitiladi, **plenty of** nimani bildiradi va **few** bilan **a few** orasidagi «bitta harf» ma'noni qanday o'zgartiradi.

**much** va **many** asosan **savol** va **inkor** gapda ishlatiladi: How **much** ...? We haven't got **many** ... Darak gapda «We drank much tea» grammatik jihatdan xato emas, lekin so'zlashuvda g'alati va rasmiy eshitiladi — o'rniga **a lot of** / **lots of** aytiladi. Lekin darak gapda ham much / many tabiiy bo'lgan holatlar bor: **too much / too many**, **so much / so many**, **as much ... as**, shuningdek rasmiy matnda: **Many** people believe ..., **Much** research has been done ... **many** darak gapda **much** ga qaraganda ko'proq uchraydi.

items.text: How **much** did you pay for the tickets to Oxford?
We spent **a lot of** money on the wedding.
There's **too much** sugar in this cake for me.
items.translation: Bu tortda men uchun shakar **juda ko'p**.

blocks.text: a lot of, lots of va plenty of

**a lot of** va **lots of** — so'zlashuv uslubi, istalgan gap turida, ikkala xil ot bilan ham. Ot bo'lmasa **of** tushib qoladi: She travels **a lot**. **plenty of** esa shunchaki «ko'p» emas — «**yetarlicha va hatto ortig'i bilan**», ya'ni xavotirga o'rin yo'q: We've got **plenty of** time — Vaqtimiz bemalol yetadi, shoshilmang. Otsiz — **plenty**: Do you need more chairs? — No, we've got **plenty**. O'zbekchada plenty ga «mo'l», «yetarli», «bemalol» to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Don't panic — we've got **plenty of** time to get to the airport.
items.translation: Vahima qilmang — aeroportga yetib olishga **vaqtimiz bemalol yetadi**.

items.text: Sarah reads **a lot**, especially on the train to work.
items.translation: Sara **ko'p** kitob o'qiydi, ayniqsa ishga ketayotib poyezdda.

items.text: There were **lots of** children at the park on Sunday.
items.translation: Yakshanba kuni bog'da bolalar **juda ko'p** edi.

blocks.text: little / few — «kam», a little / a few — «ozgina bor»

Bu darsning eng muhim nuqtasi. **a little** va **a few** — ma'no **ijobiy**: «oz, lekin **bor**, yetadi» (o'zbekcha «ozgina», «biroz», «bir nechta»). **little** va **few** — ma'no **salbiy**: «**kam**, yetarli emas, deyarli yo'q». I have **a little** money — Ozgina pulim bor (kinoga yetadi). I have **little** money — Pulim kam (muammo). So'zlashuvda yolg'iz **little / few** rasmiyroq eshitiladi, shuning uchun ko'pincha **very little / very few** yoki **not much / not many** aytiladi. Yana ikkita ibora: **only a few / only a little** — «atigi, faqat ozgina» (kamligiga urg'u); **quite a few** — «anchagina, ko'pgina» (ko'pligiga urg'u!).

rows: I've got **a few** friends here. (bir nechta bor — yaxshi)
We have **a little** time. (biroz bor — ulguramiz)

items.text: Luckily, I had **a little** money left, so I could take a taxi.
items.translation: Omadimga, **ozgina** pulim qolgan ekan, taksiga o'tira oldim.

items.text: **Few** people know that Tom was once a professional singer.
items.translation: Tom bir paytlar professional qo'shiqchi bo'lganini **kam odam** biladi.

items.text: **Quite a few** of our customers now pay by phone.
items.translation: Mijozlarimizning **anchagina qismi** endi telefon orqali to'laydi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «many money», «much friends» → **much** money, **many** friends (o'zbekcha «ko'p» ikkalasiga ham mos, inglizchada esa ot turi hal qiladi); «I have few money» → I have **little** money; «I know a few English, so I can't talk» → I know **little** English (a few — ijobiy, sanaladigan ot uchun); «There is a lot of people» → There **are** a lot of people (fe'l otga moslashadi); «We have plenty time» → **plenty of** time.

**a** harfini «yaxshi xabar» deb eslang: **a** few, **a** little — oz, lekin bor, kayfiyat ijobiy. **a** yo'q — kayfiyat ham yo'q: few, little — kam, yetmaydi. Tekshirish: gapga «xayriyat» qo'shib ko'ring — mos kelsa, **a** kerak.
Aniq guruh haqida gapirganda **of** + the / my / them qo'shiladi: many **of** my friends, a few **of** them, much **of** the time (→ 88-dars).

rows: savol, inkor; too / so / as bilan

examples.title: **much** and **many** in questions and negatives
examples.description: much — sanalmaydigan ot bilan, many — ko'plikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan. Savol va inkorda ikkalasi ham juda tabiiy: How much ...? How many ...? not much / not many.

sentences.text: How **much** luggage are you allowed to take on this flight?
sentences.translation: Bu reysga **qancha** yuk olishga ruxsat beriladi?

sentences.text: How **many** languages does your new colleague speak?
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasbingiz **nechta** tilda gapiradi?

sentences.text: I didn't get **much** sleep last night because of the neighbours' party.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarning ziyofati tufayli kecha **yaxshi uxlay olmadim**.

sentences.text: There aren't **many** cafés in this area that open before eight.
sentences.translation: Bu atrofda soat sakkizdan oldin ochiladigan kafelar **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: Did you spend **much** money on your trip to Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Edinburgga sayohatingizga **ko'p** pul sarfladingizmi?

sentences.text: Madina doesn't have **many** close friends, but she's very loyal to them.
sentences.translation: Madinaning yaqin do'stlari **ko'p emas**, lekin ularga juda sodiq.

sentences.text: We haven't had **much** rain this spring, so the farmers are worried.
sentences.translation: Bu bahor yomg'ir **ko'p yog'madi**, shuning uchun fermerlar xavotirda.

sentences.text: Were there **many** people at the protest in the city centre?
sentences.translation: Shahar markazidagi namoyishda odam **ko'pmidi**?

sentences.text: Is there **much** traffic on the road to the airport at this time?
sentences.translation: Bu paytda aeroport yo'lida **tirbandlik ko'pmi**?

sentences.text: Oliver doesn't eat **much** meat, and he doesn't drink **many** fizzy drinks either.
sentences.translation: Oliver go'shtni **ko'p yemaydi**, gazli ichimliklarni ham **ko'p ichmaydi**.

examples.title: Positive: **a lot of**, **too much**, **so many**
examples.description: Darak gapda much odatda a lot of / lots of bilan almashtiriladi. Lekin too much, so many, as much as va rasmiy uslubda (many people, much research) much / many tabiiy.

sentences.text: We drank **a lot of** tea while we were discussing the project.
sentences.translation: Loyihani muhokama qilayotganimizda **ko'p** choy ichdik.

sentences.text: There's **lots of** information about scholarships on the university website.
sentences.translation: Universitet saytida grantlar haqida **juda ko'p** ma'lumot bor.

sentences.text: **Many** people believe that coffee is bad for the heart, but the research is unclear.
sentences.translation: **Ko'p** odamlar qahva yurak uchun zararli deb hisoblaydi, lekin tadqiqotlar aniq javob bermaydi.

sentences.text: You're spending **too much** time on your phone — go outside!
sentences.translation: Telefonga **juda ko'p** vaqt sarflayapsan — tashqariga chiq!

sentences.text: There were **so many** tourists in Khiva that we couldn't take a single photo.
sentences.translation: Xivada sayyohlar **shunchalik ko'p** ediki, birorta ham surat ololmadik.

sentences.text: Jasur earns **a lot of** money, but he works twelve hours a day.
sentences.translation: Jasur **ko'p** pul topadi, lekin kuniga o'n ikki soat ishlaydi.

sentences.text: **Much** research has been done on sleep and memory in recent years.
sentences.translation: So'nggi yillarda uyqu va xotira bo'yicha **ko'plab** tadqiqotlar o'tkazildi.

sentences.text: Take **as much** bread **as** you want — there's another loaf in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: **Qancha** xohlasangiz, **shuncha** non oling — oshxonada yana bitta non bor.

sentences.text: My grandmother has **lots of** old photos of Samarkand from the 1960s.
sentences.translation: Buvimda 1960-yillardagi Samarqandning **ko'plab** eski suratlari bor.

sentences.text: I've made **so many** mistakes in this report that I'll have to start again.
sentences.translation: Bu hisobotda **shunchalik ko'p** xato qildimki, qaytadan boshlashimga to'g'ri keladi.

examples.title: **plenty of**: more than enough
examples.description: plenty of — «yetarlicha va hatto ortig'i bilan»: shoshilish yoki xavotirlanishga hojat yo'q. Ikkala xil ot bilan; otsiz — plenty.

sentences.text: Don't rush — we've got **plenty of** time before the train leaves.
sentences.translation: Shoshilmang — poyezd jo'nashigacha **vaqtimiz yetarli**.

sentences.text: There's **plenty of** food, so ask your friends to stay for dinner.
sentences.translation: Ovqat **mo'l**, do'stlaringizni kechki ovqatga olib qoling.

sentences.text: Bring a book — there will be **plenty of** chances to read on the beach.
sentences.translation: Kitob olib keling — plyajda o'qishga **imkoniyat ko'p** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Do we need more chairs? — No, we've got **plenty**.
sentences.translation: Yana stul kerakmi? — Yo'q, **yetarlicha** bor.

sentences.text: Drink **plenty of** water when you go hiking in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'da piyoda sayr qilganingizda suvni **ko'p** iching.

sentences.text: Emma has **plenty of** experience, so she'll be fine in the new role.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **tajribasi yetarli**, yangi lavozimda bemalol ishlab ketadi.

sentences.text: Is there enough parking? — Yes, there's **plenty of** space behind the building.
sentences.translation: Mashina qo'yishga joy yetadimi? — Ha, bino orqasida **joy ko'p**.

sentences.text: We had **plenty of** warning about the storm, so nobody was hurt.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron haqida **oldindan yetarlicha** ogohlantirilgan edik, shuning uchun hech kim jabrlanmadi.

sentences.text: You don't need to buy more paper — there's **plenty** in the cupboard.
sentences.translation: Yana qog'oz olishingiz shart emas — shkafda **yetarlicha** bor.

sentences.text: Bukhara has **plenty of** cheap guesthouses, so you don't have to book months in advance.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda arzon mehmon uylari **ko'p**, shuning uchun bir necha oy oldin band qilish shart emas.

examples.title: **a little** / **a few**: some, and that's enough
examples.description: a little + sanalmaydigan, a few + ko'plikdagi sanaladigan ot — «ozgina, bir nechta». Ma'no ijobiy: oz bo'lsa ham bor va yetadi.

sentences.text: Could you wait **a few** minutes? The manager is on the phone.
sentences.translation: **Bir necha** daqiqa kuta olasizmi? Menejer telefonda gaplashyapti.

sentences.text: I speak **a little** Turkish, so I can order food and ask for directions.
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** turkcha gapiraman, ovqat buyurtma qilish va yo'l so'rashga yetadi.

sentences.text: Add **a little** salt and pepper, then leave the soup on a low heat.
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** tuz va murch qo'shing, keyin sho'rvani past olovda qoldiring.

sentences.text: We spent **a few** days in Fergana visiting relatives.
sentences.translation: Qarindoshlarni ko'rgani Farg'onada **bir necha** kun bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Nilufar has saved **a little** money, so she can afford a short holiday.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **ozroq** pul yig'di, qisqa ta'tilga yetadi.

sentences.text: **A few** of my classmates now work abroad, mostly in Germany and Korea.
sentences.translation: Sinfdoshlarimdan **bir nechtasi** hozir chet elda, asosan Germaniya va Koreyada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: There's still **a little** coffee in the pot if you'd like some.
sentences.translation: Xohlasangiz, qahvadonda hali **ozgina** qahva bor.

sentences.text: I've got **a few** questions about the contract before I sign it.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldin **bir nechta** savolim bor.

sentences.text: Only **a few** people know the real reason why Tom left the company.
sentences.translation: Tomning kompaniyadan ketganining asl sababini **faqat bir necha** kishi biladi.

sentences.text: With **a little** help from her brother, Dilnoza finished the website in **a few** weeks.
sentences.translation: Akasining **ozgina** yordami bilan Dilnoza saytni **bir necha** haftada tugatdi.

examples.title: **little** / **few**: not much, not enough
examples.description: little va few (a siz) — ma'no salbiy: «kam, yetarli emas, deyarli yo'q». So'zlashuvda ko'pincha very little / very few shaklida.

sentences.text: There's **very little** hope of finding survivors after so many days.
sentences.translation: Shuncha kundan keyin tirik qolganlarni topishga **umid juda kam**.

sentences.text: **Few** people understood the new tax rules, so the office was full of complaints.
sentences.translation: Yangi soliq qoidalarini **kam odam** tushundi, shuning uchun idora shikoyatlarga to'lib ketdi.

sentences.text: Aziz has **very few** friends at his new school, and he feels lonely.
sentences.translation: Azizning yangi maktabida do'stlari **juda kam**, o'zini yolg'iz his qiladi.

sentences.text: The government did **little** to help small businesses during the crisis.
sentences.translation: Inqiroz paytida hukumat kichik biznesga yordam berish uchun **deyarli hech narsa qilmadi**.

sentences.text: We had **very little** time to prepare, so the presentation wasn't great.
sentences.translation: Tayyorlanishga **vaqtimiz juda kam** edi, shuning uchun taqdimot unchalik yaxshi chiqmadi.

sentences.text: **Few** tourists visit this village in winter because the road is closed.
sentences.translation: Qishda yo'l yopiq bo'lgani uchun bu qishloqqa sayyohlar **kam** keladi.

sentences.text: My grandfather speaks **little** English, but he understands more than you think.
sentences.translation: Bobom inglizcha **kam** gapiradi, lekin siz o'ylagandan ko'proq tushunadi.

sentences.text: **Very few** students passed the advanced exam on their first attempt.
sentences.translation: Murakkab imtihondan birinchi urinishda **juda kam** talaba o'tdi.

sentences.text: The new phone has **few** advantages over the old model, and it's much more expensive.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefonning eski modeldan **ustunliklari kam**, ustiga-ustak ancha qimmat.

sentences.text: Kate paid **little** attention to the warnings, and now she regrets it.
sentences.translation: Keyt ogohlantirishlarga **deyarli e'tibor bermadi**, endi esa pushaymon.

examples.title: **a few** or **few**? **a little** or **little**?
examples.description: Bitta harf — boshqa ma'no: a few / a little — «oz, lekin bor» (yaxshi), few / little — «kam, yetmaydi» (yomon). quite a few — «anchagina». Juft gaplarda farqni ko'ring.

sentences.text: Don't worry, we still have **a little** time before the guests arrive.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, mehmonlar kelishigacha hali **biroz** vaqtimiz bor.

sentences.text: Hurry — we have **little** time, and the shop closes in ten minutes!
sentences.translation: Shoshiling — **vaqtimiz kam**, do'kon o'n daqiqadan keyin yopiladi!

sentences.text: I know **a few** people in Manchester, so I won't feel alone there.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda **bir nechta** tanishim bor, u yerda o'zimni yolg'iz his qilmayman.

sentences.text: Sarah knows **few** people in the city, and she often feels homesick.
sentences.translation: Sara shaharda **kam odamni** taniydi, tez-tez uyini sog'inadi.

sentences.text: Luckily, the hotel had **a few** rooms left, so we didn't have to sleep in the car.
sentences.translation: Omadimizga, mehmonxonada **bir nechta** xona qolgan ekan, mashinada uxlashimizga to'g'ri kelmadi.

sentences.text: Sadly, the town has **few** hotels, so book early if you want to stay there.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, shaharchada mehmonxonalar **kam**, u yerda qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, oldindan band qiling.

sentences.text: James saved **a little** money every month and bought a car after two years.
sentences.translation: Jeyms har oy **ozgina** pul yig'ib, ikki yildan keyin mashina sotib oldi.

sentences.text: His younger brother saves **very little** and spends almost everything on clothes.
sentences.translation: Ukasi esa **juda kam** pul yig'adi, topganining deyarli hammasini kiyimga sarflaydi.

sentences.text: The film was quite boring, but it had **a few** funny moments.
sentences.translation: Film ancha zerikarli edi, lekin unda **bir nechta** kulgili lahza bor edi.

sentences.text: **Quite a few** of my colleagues cycle to work now — that's more than ten people!
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarimning **anchagina qismi** endi ishga velosipedda keladi — o'ndan ortiq odam!

examples.title: Without a noun: not **much**, **a lot**, **a little**
examples.description: much, many, a lot, a little, a few, few otsiz ham keladi — ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa yoki fe'ldan keyin: I don't sleep much, He travels a lot, It hurts a little.

sentences.text: Do you go to the gym **much**? — Not **much**, maybe once a month.
sentences.translation: Sport zaliga **ko'p** borasizmi? — **Unchalik emas**, oyda bir marta bo'lsa kerak.

sentences.text: Bekzod travels **a lot** for work, so he's rarely at home.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ish bilan **ko'p** safarga chiqadi, shuning uchun kamdan-kam uyda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I'd like more photos of the wedding, but I only took **a few**.
sentences.translation: To'ydan ko'proq surat bo'lsa yaxshi edi, lekin men **bir nechtasini** olganman, xolos.

sentences.text: My back hurts **a little**, but I can still play tennis.
sentences.translation: Belim **biroz** og'riyapti, lekin hali tennis o'ynay olaman.

sentences.text: How **many** of the guests have replied? — Not **many**, only about twenty.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlardan **nechtasi** javob berdi? — **Ko'p emas**, atigi yigirmatacha.

sentences.text: The new medicine helps **a lot**, and Grandma is sleeping much better now.
sentences.translation: Yangi dori **juda** yordam beryapti, buvim endi ancha yaxshi uxlayapti.

sentences.text: We haven't seen each other **much** since Kate moved to London.
sentences.translation: Keyt Londonga ko'chganidan beri bir-birimizni **kam** ko'ryapmiz.

sentences.text: Is your English getting better? — Yes, **a little**, thanks to the online course.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz yaxshilanyaptimi? — Ha, **biroz**, onlayn kurs tufayli.

sentences.text: There used to be a lot of fish in this lake, but now there are very **few**.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'lda ilgari baliq ko'p edi, lekin hozir **juda kam**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza reads **a lot**, but she watches very **little** television.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **ko'p** kitob o'qiydi, lekin televizorni **juda kam** ko'radi.

examples.title: Mixed: quantities in news, health and money
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: much / many, a lot of, plenty of, (a) little, (a) few — real hayotdagi murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: According to the survey, **few** young people read newspapers, but **many** listen to podcasts.
sentences.translation: So'rovnomaga ko'ra, gazeta o'qiydigan yoshlar **kam**, lekin **ko'pchiligi** podkast tinglaydi.

sentences.text: The doctor told me to drink **plenty of** water and to eat **very little** salt.
sentences.translation: Shifokor menga suvni **ko'p** ichishni va tuzni **juda kam** yeyishni aytdi.

sentences.text: How **much** did the repairs cost? — Not **a lot**, just **a few** hundred pounds.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir **qanchaga** tushdi? — **Ko'p emas**, atigi **bir necha** yuz funt.

sentences.text: There isn't **much** we can do about the delay, so let's have **a little** patience.
sentences.translation: Kechikish bo'yicha **ko'p narsa** qila olmaymiz, shuning uchun **biroz** sabr qilaylik.

sentences.text: **A lot of** small shops in the old town have closed, and **few** new ones have opened.
sentences.translation: Eski shahardagi **ko'plab** kichik do'konlar yopildi, yangilari esa **kam** ochildi.

sentences.text: We've got **plenty of** volunteers for Saturday, but we need **a few** more drivers.
sentences.translation: Shanba uchun ko'ngillilar **yetarli**, lekin yana **bir nechta** haydovchi kerak.

sentences.text: Jasur had **little** money but **a lot of** ambition when he started his business.
sentences.translation: Jasur biznesini boshlaganda puli **kam**, lekin intilishi **katta** edi.

sentences.text: Only **a few** of the apps on my phone are really useful — the rest just take up space.
sentences.translation: Telefonimdagi ilovalarning **faqat bir nechtasi** haqiqatan foydali — qolganlari shunchaki joy egallaydi.

sentences.text: I didn't have **many** chances to practise English in the village, so I watched **a lot of** films.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda ingliz tilini mashq qilishga **imkoniyatim kam** edi, shuning uchun **ko'p** film ko'rdim.

sentences.text: So **many** people applied for the job that the company had **very little** time to read every CV.
sentences.translation: Bu ishga **shunchalik ko'p** odam hujjat topshirdiki, kompaniyada har bir rezyumeni o'qishga **vaqt juda kam** edi.
